scope: Read-only current-source scaling audit, after levy HUD fix. No production code changes. Simulation profile and function-entry count run are separate isolated replays of captured live state.

profile.method: Current source simulation-only Node V8 CPU sample on captured live game, navigation WASM enabled. Warm30steps;360profiledsteps dt1/30=12game seconds. Movement instrumentation enabled. No rendering/HUD; no livegame interaction. Inclusive costs overlap; sampling/timing are diagnostic, not an FPS forecast.

callCounts.method: Diagnostic-only AST instrumentation in a temporary bundle, function entry counts over360updates/12game seconds after30warmupsteps on capturedstate. No source edits; counts include cache hits and gated calls, and are not full recomputation counts.

findings.cadence: Many queries per substep; territory averaged 8.39 calls per update in replay
findings.risk: Cache hits still scan all buildings or critical structures; repeated O(B) validation fans out through fog, traffic, healing and city logic.
findings.alternative: Explicit claim/topology revisions and retained village/source indexes. Recompute only on relevant source or culture-radius threshold changes.

findings.cadence: updateFog 18.75 entries/update, refreshSightSources 3.29/update in replay; memory roughly 10 Hz plus invalidations
findings.risk: Incremental coverage still surrounded by global U+B source discovery and B+fields memory validation; presentation scans map cells.
findings.alternative: Dirty source/entity/cell queues populated by movement, spawn, death, ownership and completion events; reuse one validated view per phase.

findings.cadence: Nominal 3 Hz; synchronizeFarms 85, ensureCollectors 97, ensureBuilders 77 calls in 12 game seconds
findings.risk: Generic world/entity revisions wake whole-world reconciliation; well/neighborhood/enclosure checks run before farm-topology early return.
findings.alternative: Per-city workforce/farm/route revisions. Update housing on local well/post/population/enclosure changes; schedule downgrade deadlines.

findings.area: Target validation and failed weapon sensing
findings.cadence: Retained target LOS/contact before the 3/8 Hz gate; failed tower/ballista searches each step at zero cooldown
findings.risk: Throttles do not gate all expensive work; out-of-range building urgency repeatedly bypasses sensing limits.
findings.alternative: Cheap live validity checks; geometry checks on cell/topology changes and immediately before firing; idle sensor deadlines and threat-entry wakeups.

findings.area: Attack reservations, route congestion and global route revisions
findings.cadence: Per candidate attack target and per reroute; route nodes checked after a global world revision
findings.risk: Global reservation scan per target; O(queries*(units+reservations)) congestion rebuild; O(movers*route length) broad invalidation.
findings.alternative: Cell/target reservation indexes, shared incremental faction congestion fields and regional route stamps.

findings.area: Builder job selection and guard-post planning
findings.cadence: Idle builder decisions at 3 Hz with a two-second no-job backoff; guard-post bookkeeping every substep
findings.risk: Each idle worker scans same construction/repair roster; each post filters civilians and associates cities.
findings.alternative: Per-city job queues/reservations; maintained post/worker membership and shared local threat snapshots.

findings.cadence: Leader/city scans every substep before the one-second planning gate
findings.risk: Faction*(units+buildings) preprocessing and enemy*observer tests; duplicated rosters.
findings.alternative: Indexed faction rosters, early deadline gate, shared spatial threat snapshot per planning epoch.

findings.cadence: Moving formations every substep; costly reassignment on transitions; separation every substep
findings.risk: Repeated member assignment can approach quadratic; local-density pair work grows even with spatial buckets.
findings.alternative: Persistent slot ownership, changed-member assignment, unique collision pairs and bounded yield-chain work.

findings.risk: Linear world scans/allocations evenwhen no harvest is due; notthe previously fixed quadratic validation per visit.
findings.alternative: Persistent field indexes, occupied-farm updates on cell transitions, dirty claims and deadline queues.

findings.cadence: Every movingmerchant update before route retry gate
findings.risk: Perboat rebuilding of building/unit obstacle maps scalesboats × (buildings+units).
findings.alternative: Shared static water topology and incremental boat occupancy; only local exception per boat.

findings.area: Lifecycle, squad, supply and levy maintenance
findings.cadence: Unconditional lifecycle passes each step; squads twice and levy three times per step
findings.risk: Repeated O(U+B) loops/temporary arrays evenwhen no changes; supply ID scan before the 30-second deadline. Low current measured priority for levy/squads.
findings.alternative: Creation/death/role events, injured/due sets, retained rosters, monotonic ID allocator and deadlines before prep.

findings.cadence: Every rendered frame; HUD every 150 ms; detailed activity when open
findings.risk: Rebuild global building/field maps, scan all units, sort/rebuild display list, redraw minimap; shimmer uses 256 samples per protected tile.
findings.alternative: Retained static/entity layers, viewport spatial queries, minimap dots at 5–10 Hz, shader/cached shimmer and HUD updates when values change.

findings.risk: Synchronous full-world serialization/localStorage; visibility checks before geometric rejection may repeat global fog validation per click.
findings.alternative: Worker/asynchronoussnapshot persistence; one fog view and spatial/geometric culling per click.

notes: Inclusive profile percentages overlap and cannot be added.
Function entry counts include cheap cache hits and early returns; do not treat all calls as full recomputation.
The snapshot has about 400 units; it is not a thousands-unit stress test. Scaling risks are derived from code, not an FPS forecast.

Already working: levy HUD cache, one-second city ribbon cache, courier sleep, incremental fog coverage, spatial buckets, formation width/column traversal optimizations, and empty-wildlife early return.
